        "    cls_path = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, cls)\n",
        "    all_files = os.listdir(cls_path)\n",
        "    random.seed(SEED)\n",

        "\n",
        "    n = len(all_files)\n",
        "    n_train = int(0.70 * n)\n",
        "    n_val   = int(0.15 * n)\n",
        "\n",
        "    train_files = all_files[:n_train]\n",
        "    val_files   = all_files[n_train : n_train + n_val]\n",
        "    test_files  = all_files[n_train + n_val :]\n",
        "\n",
        "    for fname in train_files:\n",
        "        shutil.copy(os.path.join(cls_path, fname),\n",
        "                    os.path.join(SPLIT_DIR, \"train\", cls, fname))\n",
        "    for fname in val_files:\n",
        "        shutil.copy(os.path.join(cls_path, fname),\n",
        "                    os.path.join(SPLIT_DIR, \"val\", cls, fname))\n",
        "    for fname in test_files:\n",
        "        shutil.copy(os.path.join(cls_path, fname),\n",
        "                    os.path.join(SPLIT_DIR, \"test\", cls, fname))\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(f\"  {cls}: {len(train_files)} train | {len(val_files)} val | {len(test_files)} test\")"

      "source": [
        "def build_fnn():\n",
        "    model = models.Sequential([\n",
        "\n",
        "        layers.Flatten(input_shape=INPUT_SHAPE),\n",
        "\n",
        "        layers.Dense(256, activation=\"relu\"),\n",
        "\n",
        "        layers.Dropout(0.4),\n",
        "\n",
        "        layers.Dense(128, activation=\"relu\"),\n",
        "        layers.Dropout(0.3),\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "        layers.Dense(1, activation=\"sigmoid\")\n",
        "    ])\n",
        "    return model"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": 30,
      "metadata": {
        "id": "x0sB0azr8Dig"
      },
      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "def build_basic_cnn():\n",
        "    model = models.Sequential([\n",
        "\n",
        "        layers.Conv2D(32, (3, 3), activation=\"relu\", input_shape=INPUT_SHAPE),\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "        layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),\n",
        "\n",
        "        layers.Conv2D(64, (3, 3), activation=\"relu\"),\n",
        "        layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),\n",
        "\n",
        "        layers.Flatten(),\n",
        "        layers.Dense(128, activation=\"relu\"),\n",
        "        layers.Dense(1, activation=\"sigmoid\")\n",
        "    ])\n",
        "    return model"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": 32,
      "metadata": {
        "id": "qm9sVDQD8Niu"
      },
      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "def build_deep_cnn():\n",
        "    model = models.Sequential([\n",
        "        layers.Conv2D(32, (3, 3), activation=\"relu\", input_shape=INPUT_SHAPE),\n",
        "        layers.BatchNormalization(),\n",
        "        layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),\n",
        "\n",
        "        layers.Conv2D(64, (3, 3), activation=\"relu\"),\n",
        "        layers.BatchNormalization(),\n",
        "        layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),\n",
        "\n",
        "        layers.Conv2D(128, (3, 3), activation=\"relu\"),\n",
        "        layers.BatchNormalization(),\n",
        "        layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),\n",
        "\n",
        "        layers.Flatten(),\n",
        "        layers.Dense(256, activation=\"relu\"),\n",
        "        layers.Dropout(0.5),\n",
        "        layers.Dense(128, activation=\"relu\"),\n",
        "        layers.Dropout(0.3),\n",
        "        layers.Dense(1, activation=\"sigmoid\")\n",
        "    ])\n",
        "    return model"
      ]
    },

        "def plot_history(history, model_name, save_path):\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    This function draws two charts side by side:\n",
        "    Left chart:  training loss vs validation loss over epochs\n",
        "    Right chart: training accuracy vs validation accuracy over epochs\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))\n",
        "    fig.suptitle(f\"Training Curves — {model_name}\", fontsize=13)\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Loss chart\n",
        "    axes[0].plot(history.history[\"loss\"],     label=\"Train Loss\",      color=\"blue\")\n",
        "    axes[0].plot(history.history[\"val_loss\"], label=\"Validation Loss\", color=\"orange\")\n",
        "    axes[0].set_title(\"Loss over Epochs\")\n",
        "    axes[0].set_xlabel(\"Epoch\")\n",
        "    axes[0].set_ylabel(\"Loss\")\n",
        "    axes[0].legend()\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Accuracy chart\n",
        "    axes[1].plot(history.history[\"accuracy\"],     label=\"Train Accuracy\",      color=\"blue\")\n",
        "    axes[1].plot(history.history[\"val_accuracy\"], label=\"Validation Accuracy\", color=\"orange\")\n",
        "    axes[1].set_title(\"Accuracy over Epochs\")\n",
        "    axes[1].set_xlabel(\"Epoch\")\n",
        "    axes[1].set_ylabel(\"Accuracy\")\n",
        "    axes[1].legend()\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()"
      ]
    },

        "def evaluate_model(model, test_gen, model_name):\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    Runs the model on test images, then calculates:\n",
        "    - Accuracy  = % of correct predictions\n",
        "    - Precision = of all \"dog\" predictions, how many were actually dogs?\n",
        "    - Recall    = of all actual dogs, how many did the model find?\n",
        "    - F1        = harmonic mean [balanced average] of Precision and Recall\n",
        "    - AUC-ROC   = how well the model separates the two classes (1.0 = perfect)\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    \n",
        "    \n",
        "    test_gen.reset()  \n",
        "    y_probs = model.predict(test_gen, verbose=0)  \n",
        "    y_pred  = (y_probs > 0.5).astype(int).flatten()  \n",
        "    y_true  = test_gen.classes  \n",
        "\n",
        "    \n",
        "    print(f\"\\n--- {model_name} ---\")\n",
        "    report = classification_report(y_true, y_pred, target_names=class_names, output_dict=True)\n",
        "    print(classification_report(y_true, y_pred, target_names=class_names))\n",
        "\n",
        "    \n",
        "    auc = roc_auc_score(y_true, y_probs)\n",
        "    print(f\"AUC-ROC: {auc:.4f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    \n",
        "    accuracy  = report[\"accuracy\"]\n",
        "    precision = report[\"weighted avg\"][\"precision\"]\n",
        "    recall    = report[\"weighted avg\"][\"recall\"]\n",
        "    f1        = report[\"weighted avg\"][\"f1-score\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "    return {\n",
        "        \"Model\":     model_name,\n",
        "        \"Accuracy\":  round(accuracy,  4),\n",
        "        \"Precision\": round(precision, 4),\n",
        "        \"Recall\":    round(recall,    4),\n",
        "        \"F1-Score\":  round(f1,        4),\n",
        "        \"AUC-ROC\":   round(auc,       4),\n",
        "    }, y_true, y_pred"
      ]
    },
